strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed. 2. Victory conditions not met within 20 turns.
Plant planet confirmed.
It's already this close...!?
It's close. ...And the enemy's set up a pretty thick defensive line.
So you've come, Earthlings. But it's already too late...!
The moment the great Dirad takes root... see it with your own eyes...!
Lord Shapiro... I'm going to take your homeworld...
I can't believe not firing the colony laser is costing us this much...!
The other side's desperate too.
Ramming us with an entire planet... That's unheard of...
Oh? I don't see Shapiro Keats's machine.
Come to think of it, he's nowhere to be seen...
We didn't finish him last time... Now he's watching from on high!?
No faaair!
It's a clever approach, though.
He's not here? At a crucial moment like this, he's not here...?
Sara? Don't tell me you're going to go looking for him...
Don't insult me, Ryo. I've decided... I'm done wavering!
Come on, come on, this is no time for that!
Bright, I'm heading out!
Captain, how much time... until the planet gets here!?
Are you serious about this!? The enemy base is right in front of us!
Captain, how much time... until the planet gets here!?
...Twenty minutes...! We can't buy any more than that!
Twenty minutes!?
No, that's all!?
Even if we charge straight in... will we make it?
We got no time at all, dagnabbit!
We'll never make it in time, Brother...!
A heart that never gives up till the end... That is what brings victory.
Rom's right. We've made it this far... all that's left is to fight.
Yeah! The great Gai Daigoji will wrap this up at super-express speed!
The Gandor unit has the ground. ...This is our moment of truth. Sortie!
Hell yeah! Let's do it!
I cannot lose this battle! Kenrouuu!
Heh heh heh... What can you do with such a meager force!
Lady Diore, it's nearly time... We, the Dirad people who lost our star...
our long-cherished wish is about to come true...!
(Lord Shapiro... We will take your homeworld... And when we do...)
Heh, we're short on time, but there's not many more of 'em than usual!
Let's scatter 'em!
Twenty minutes is plenty. Easier than stopping that colony was.
...Even if we clear them out in twenty minutes... the planet may not stop.
Good point...! What do we do then!?
...We'll have no choice but to destroy the planet itself.
How!? Even if we all fire at once...
If outside won't work... then from the inside.
That's right. Besides... Shapiro might be inside...
Heh heh heh... It's over, lowly Earthlings...! Commence attack!
Dunno if we're lowly, but we're not about to lose to you bastards!
Kyosuke... you hang in there too, okay...!?
Big Sis Diondra! This is the spot!
Don't call me Big Sis! ...Oh? They mean to ram the whole planet into it?
A battle this big... I expected someone to butt in, but...!
Ah, Brother, look!
...Tch.
Oh, great, a whole tour group just showed up, Rom!
Diondra...!
Ho ho ho, looks like you're busy, Rom.
Coming out in person... What's gotten into you, Diondra?
I'm cleaning up after my useless underlings,
who never manage to beat the likes of you.
And besides... I've found out about the treasure on Earth.
Treasure? Come to think of it, Rom and the others mentioned that...
So you're after the special energy on Earth!
Treasure? I see, that's what Rom and Dr. Tarsan were talking about!
You're after a substitute for the energy you failed to get on Cronos!
So it's just as Dr. Tarsan and Rom said...!
We ain't losin' this time! We don't give a damn what happens to this planet!
We'll beat you all to a pulp, grab the treasure, and see ya later!
Say whatever you like! What, too scared to come alone?
Aha! This time you didn't think up a parting line for your getaway!
Whaddya say, you little...
Don't rise to the bait, Devil Saturn 6. That's just what they want...
Oh well, didn't work.
...Shut that down with one word. Who is he?
Kills the mood of a conversation with one word... I can't stand that type.
I've never seen him before... Is that the Gyandlar's boss!?
...No, that's not Gades...! Who are you!
So you are Rom Stol. Heh... I'd like to say I have no name to give,
but I'll tell you. My name is Gardy.
I've taken an interest in you.
We're busy here. If it's just curiosity, I'd rather you stayed out of it.
Don't be shy. Let me see what you're capable of in this battle.
(I feel like I've met this man before... What is this? And... Gardy?
Is it... a coincidence?)
Forget the small talk! Rom! This time I'll finish you!
Master Rom, that girl is...!
This is gonna be an all-out war...
The plant planet's people are after Earth itself, while the Gyandlar
are after something on Earth.
...Which means the one obstacle they share is us.
Enemies everywhere. Gimme a break already!
Ngh... More enemies or not, time won't wait for us!
Take them out one at a time! I'm counting on you all!
Akito, go for it!
Easy for you to say... but here goes!
Rom... my father's killer... I swear...!
That is unmistakably Kenrou!
It's like my Kenrou!
What is the name of your sword!
Kenrou!
Heh! My sword is Nagase! Remember that name!
The two swords are fated to fight until one of them shatters!
What!?
We're running out of time...!
Don't panic, Lieutenant. Their numbers are dropping fast.
Keep it up...!
Ngh!? Raideen!?
...Th-this... awful feeling...
...Judau... Judau! This feeling!
Ngh, what is this...!? Judau, do you feel it!?
What's wrong, everyone!?
Ugh... ungh... Brother...
Maria, you too!?
...Danger... Brother... It's that thing... It'll do something bad to Earth...
To... protect Earth...
Maria! What's wrong!? Sayaka, are you okay!?
Yes, I'm fine! Boss, what about you!?
Maria!? I don't get it. What about that enemy!?
This has never happened before!? Boss, are you all right?
I'm fine, dagnabbit. More importantly, can we even fight like this!?
Morale's broken!? Is it an enemy attack!?
No... This is the pressure of that thing from when we met up with Akira...!
Several Ra Cailum pilots seem to be in a state of confusion...!
What!?
Ruri, anything unusual!?
...Unidentified unit approaching.
They showed up again! Hey, wait, that huge thing is...!?
Like the Gyandlar, they've brought out an officer-class unit too.
Dammit, being big doesn't make you tough!
This is no time to be so laid-back! What do we do!?
What else can we do but smash it?
Come on, what's wrong with you all!?
...This... Pla...net... From...
...That... voice... I knew it... the same... as that time...
Raideen... Is this a will to reject it!?
Raideen, answer me! Raideen!
What is this? We've fought them before... but this time something's off.
It's close to malice... and yet I sense something entirely different...
Brother, what's going on? Some people are in pain!?
Get a grip! This is no time to be wiped out!?
What's wrong with everyone!?
I don't know... but...! We have to beat that... We have to beat it...!
What are you saying!? You're not complete... huh...!?
...That's exactly right.
...You... again!
That red robot... again...!
Excellen!
Don't worry, Akira. I'm fine... I'm fine.
Yes... there's nothing to worry about. Excellen... it should be soon...
...You mean it's past the kiddo's bedtime? Then good night.
(What that girl's thinking... that giant thing... I kinda... get it...?
Kyosuke... what's happening to me...?)
What's that...? Hmph, it seems plenty of others have their eye on Earth.
This is getting interesting.
Oh? It seems they'll hold them off for us.
Should I see this as an opportunity?
...Lord Shapiro... What would you do...?
That will be all for tonight. ...Excellen.
The time draws near. You should know that too...
If the land of beginnings vanishes here... that's fine, too.
Land of... beginnings...?
Perhaps that would be better... for me, and for you as well...
...What... are you saying? Land of beginnings... a new... universe...?
I'll be waiting...
You must hate me, Kina...
But I can't afford to die right now, either.
Why!? You killed my father! Lady Diondra told me!
That Rom took my father by treachery, and he died with regret!
That you trapped him and cut him down from behind!
No! Brother would never do something like that!
We didn't see it! Why should we trust what Rom's friends say!
Diondra, your methods are as dirty as ever.
...But tell me, do you really think Rom is the kind of man
who'd pull such a filthy stunt?
Lady Diondra said so! She said Rom is a coward!
Then what about Diondra, who ran off and left you behind?
If you've lost sight of the truth, dancing to a false lust for revenge...
then I'll cut you down...!
Without regard for their own safety,
friends who put their lives on the line fighting alongside us...
Are they cowards?
...Ngh.
Kina. If I defeated Jingi by foul means...
Heaven will judge me one day. If you think it's now, then come at me.
Brother...
...But I can't die yet. If it's my fate to fight and be wounded,
then fighting and winning is my duty...! I'll fight you with all I have.
Ngh! To come up with lines like that so smoothly...
that guy's a hero through and through!
Is this the time to be impressed!? He's way too close!
If she runs him through there, he's done for!
No, it seems there's no need to worry, Shinobu... The spirit of martial arts.
Whatever the planet or the body, that spirit alone never changes.
Sis...
...A true martial artist... Very well, Rom Stol.
I'll be there to see when heaven's judgment falls on you...!
Yes, I can't promise when that will be. But I'll stay true to my code, Kina.
Acquired skill "Hard Worker".
Did we do it!? Is it over!?
I don't see any more enemies, but...
Looks that way. Phew...
Don't let your guard down. Captain, what about the asteroid!?
...It isn't stopping.
Whaaat!!
No good!?
After all we did... all we can do now is watch!?
What... what is this...!
Is there a way!? Captain Bright, isn't there any way left!?
What am I supposed to tell Koji and the others!
We stopped Iron Mask's plan... How can it end like this!
...Seabook...
...We charge in.
...Let's charge in.
Shinobu!?
Yurika!?
Looks like that's all we've got.
Though I hate that it's the same as when we fought that Muge bastard.
Yeah, well, we can't think of anything better, so it can't be helped.
Hold on, with no chance of winning!?
Exactly. If we were wiped out on that asteroid...
Nergal... no, the Federation would suffer irreparable losses!
Even so, it seems this is our only option other than watching.
Agreed. This is no time to be fussing over Nergal.
If we're wiped out, everything's over anyway.
Hmm...
"If you don't enter the tiger's den, you can't catch its cub"... is that it?
What's that mean?
A proverb meaning "if you take no risks, you get no matching reward."
The spirit of high risk, high return.
...Still, Duke Fleed... for an alien, you know a lot.
If there's a tiger cub, that is.
...There may be nothing, but it's more of a chance than staying here.
...All units, return to the ship.
Londo Bell will now storm the core of the enemy asteroid...!
...It's the only way, huh. Here goes...!
Heh, we'll find out once we're inside.
Rom, this has nothing to do with the Gyandlar... It's a fight for Earthlings.
Thank you... for everything until now.
Captain? What are you saying?
Hey, hey, don't be such a stranger.
Seriously, though, this has nothing to do with you guys, right?
I haven't seen hell enough to turn my back on those who risk their lives.
Let's go, everyone.
Thank you... Rom.
Dammit, he gets me every time... Come on!
Even people from another planet are lending a hand! Let's go, everyone!
Yeah, we've got no choice...!
Gekiganger always got through pinches like this too...!
Then the Nadesico will also retrieve the Aestivalis team,
and promptly prepare to go in. ...This is kind of exciting.
We're not kids exploring the block... But what'll become of us...?
We'll find out once we go in. ...If we're still alive, that is.
Big shake-ups, on the ground... and in space. Kyosuke... I'm going ahead...!
(Though I don't know what'll happen to me either...)
Acquired skill "Comeback".
Acquired skill "Command".
